projectContext: Sprint 12 implements the 3-tier escalation bypass system for yt-dlp downloads. Tier 1 (always-on impersonation via curl_cffi) was completed in Sprint 9 (US-001-005) and wired into all 8 yt-dlp call sites. This sprint builds Tier 2 (extractor-args player_client rotation on 403/bot detection) and Tier 3 (combined impersonation + extractor-args + cookie rotation). Key gaps: no EscalationManager exists, no extractor-args injection, 403 errors currently only trigger cookie fallback without player_client bypass, no tests for ImpersonationManager or escalation flow. Sprint 10 planned escalation but completed 0/10 stories. Sprint 11 focused on robustness. curl_cffi v0.13.0 is installed with 31 impersonation targets available.

userStories.title: Create EscalationTier enum and EscalationState dataclass in types.py
userStories.description: Define the data model for the 3-tier escalation system. EscalationTier enum represents the three levels (IMPERSONATE_ONLY, EXTRACTOR_ARGS, FULL_BYPASS). EscalationState tracks per-keyword escalation progression with attempt counts and timestamps.
acceptanceCriteria: Add EscalationTier enum to src/downloader/types.py with values: IMPERSONATE_ONLY=1, EXTRACTOR_ARGS=2, FULL_BYPASS=3
Add EscalationState dataclass with fields: current_tier (EscalationTier), consecutive_403s (int), last_escalation_time (Optional[float]), extractor_args_index (int), escalation_history (List[tuple])
Add EscalationState.should_escalate(threshold: int = 2) method returning bool based on consecutive_403s >= threshold
Add EscalationState.escalate() method that advances tier and resets consecutive_403s counter
Add EscalationState.record_success() method that resets consecutive_403s but keeps current tier
Run: python -m py_compile src/downloader/types.py (no errors)
Commit: feat: [US-001] Create EscalationTier enum and EscalationState dataclass
userStories.notes: Implemented EscalationTier IntEnum (IMPERSONATE_ONLY=1, EXTRACTOR_ARGS=2, FULL_BYPASS=3) and EscalationState dataclass with should_escalate(), escalate(), record_success() methods. Exported in __init__.py. 71 downloader tests pass, 1 pre-existing failure unrelated.

userStories.title: Create EscalationManager with per-keyword tier tracking and extractor-args generation
userStories.description: Build the EscalationManager class that orchestrates the 3-tier bypass progression. Tracks escalation state per keyword, generates appropriate yt-dlp arguments for each tier, and manages cooldown-based de-escalation. Thread-safe for concurrent downloads.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/downloader/escalation_manager.py with EscalationManager class

Implement get_tier_args(keyword: str) -> List[str] that returns yt-dlp args based on current tier: Tier 1 returns [] (impersonation handled separately), Tier 2 returns ['--extractor-args', 'youtube:player_client=<next_client>'], Tier 3 returns Tier 2 args (cookie rotation handled separately)
Implement record_403(keyword: str) that increments consecutive_403s and auto-escalates when threshold reached
Implement record_success(keyword: str) that resets 403 counter but maintains tier (sticky escalation within session)
Implement get_status() -> dict returning per-keyword tier states and escalation event counts
Use threading.Lock for thread-safety (same pattern as ImpersonationManager)
Player client rotation: cycle through ExtractorArgsConfig.player_clients round-robin per keyword
Run: python -m py_compile src/downloader/escalation_manager.py
Commit: feat: [US-003] Create EscalationManager with per-keyword tier tracking
userStories.notes: Core escalation logic. Tier 1 is always-on via ImpersonationManager (separate). EscalationManager handles Tier 2-3 progression only.

userStories.title: Wire EscalationManager into core.py keyword search and ID-based download
userStories.description: Integrate the EscalationManager into VideoDownloader's two main download paths in core.py. On every download attempt, call get_tier_args(keyword) and append to yt-dlp command. On 403 error, call record_403(keyword). On success, call record_success(keyword).
acceptanceCriteria: Import EscalationManager in core.py and initialize in VideoDownloader.__init__ (pass ExtractorArgsConfig from download config)
In _run_download_cmd (keyword search path ~line 1591): append escalation_manager.get_tier_args(keyword) to yt-dlp command
In _download_by_id (ID-based path ~line 1688): append escalation_manager.get_tier_args(keyword) to yt-dlp command
On _is_auth_error() detection in retry loop: call escalation_manager.record_403(keyword) BEFORE existing cookie fallback
On successful download: call escalation_manager.record_success(keyword)
Log escalation events at WARNING level: 'Escalating to Tier {n} for keyword: {kw} (after {count} 403s)'
Run: pytest tests/test_downloader_core.py tests/test_downloader_core_advanced.py -v --tb=short (no regressions)
Commit: feat: [US-004] Wire EscalationManager into core.py download paths
userStories.notes: Follows same wiring pattern as ImpersonationManager (Sprint 9 US-003). Escalation args are additive.
